# `publisher_model_rewrite`

Strips the `publishers/{namespace}/models/` prefix from the request body's `model` field.

## Configuration Notes

When a client sends `"model": "publishers/llm-internal/models/facebook/opt-125m"`, this filter rewrites the body to `"model": "facebook/opt-125m"` so the upstream (e.g. vLLM) receives the model name it expects.

Place this filter after `model_to_header` in the chain so the full publisher path is available for routing before the body is rewritten.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | no | Maximum request body size to buffer before parsing. |

## Example

```yaml
filter: publisher_model_rewrite
max_body_bytes: 10485760  # optional, defaults to 10 MiB
```
